summary: Polk County 100-ft Aermotor LS-40 tower built in 1939 by the Florida Division of Forestry and registered in 2016; no public access information found.

facts.agency: Florida Department of Agriculture & Consumer Services (administers); built by the Florida Division of Forestry
facts.status_note: Listed in its 2016 register entry as possibly still operated as fire danger requires; the register does not describe its current condition.

access.note: The register does not say whether the public may enter the site or climb the tower.

notes_for_editor: Single source: the NHLR entry was the only page read that gives a build date and design. The NHLR 'Elevation' of 103 ft (31 m) is ground elevation, not tower height, so the brief's elevation_m 31.4 is ground elevation. The Lakeland Ledger 2015 article on Polk's aging towers returned HTTP 403 when fetched; its search snippet suggests the tower near Lake Pierce was 'barely hanging on', which would change the status. Check it before publishing. The FL DEP Broussard Catfish Creek Preserve plan says park access is from Firetower Road south of Lake Hatchineha Road, but it does not confirm the tower's location, so it was not cited. Page reads: 6.
